title: AI-First CFOs Deliver 23% Higher Growth — But Verification Eats 26% of the Week
tagline: Preparing Business Students for the AI-Powered Economy
key_facts: IBM 2026 CFO Study (1,500 CFOs): 62% of CFOs have expanded responsibilities into enterprise technology or AI strategy leadership.
Organizations led by AI-first CFOs achieved revenue growth rates 23% higher than peers (2022-2024).
Only 6% of finance organizations are transformation-ready with AI embedded at enterprise scale.
Datarails 2026 CFO Survey (270 CFOs): Finance teams spend average 26% of workweek verifying or correcting AI outputs.
96% of CFOs spend at least 10% of time on AI verification; only 5% trust AI for board-ready reports without review.
Lack of auditability is the top barrier (75%), followed by accuracy/hallucinations (71%).
Deloitte: 54% of finance leaders lead cross-enterprise AI and technology capital allocation.
philosophy: AI generates. DATA informs. FINANCE measures. ACCOUNTING verifies. HUMAN JUDGMENT decides.
